title: College Football
desc: The Colorado Buffaloes host the No. 12 Texas Tech Red Raiders at Folsom Field in Boulder. The Buffaloes lost 23-13 to the Bears and rely on quarterback Julian Lewis, while the Red Raiders beat the Bearkats, 49-14, paced by quarterback Will Hammond.

title: College Football
desc: Northwestern hosts Penn State in a Big Ten Week 5 matchup under the lights at Ryan Field. Northwestern enters after posting 325 total yards in a 29-23 loss at Indiana, while Penn State recorded 233 yards in a 24-20 home loss to Wisconsin on Sept. 26.
